    output = [[0] * out_cols for _ in range(out_rows)]
    
    for r in range(out_rows):
        for c in range(out_cols):
            section_vals = set()
            for i in range(r_bounds[r], r_bounds[r+1]):
                for j in range(c_bounds[c], c_bounds[c+1]):
                    val = grid[i][j]
                    section_vals.add(val)
            
            output[r][c] = len(section_vals)
    
    return output
